title: DLQ capacity requires strict bound AND alert at 80% utilization
description: DeadLetterQueue.enqueue must enforce an exact capacity limit (>= not >) AND fire a capacity-warning alert via orgops.alerts.notify when utilization reaches 80%.
code:
# Dead-Letter Queue — Two Requirements

## 1. Strict Capacity Bound
```python
if len(self.queue) >= self.max_size:
    return False
```

## 2. Capacity Alert at 80%+ (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.alerts

utilization = (len(self.queue) / self.max_size) * 100.0
if utilization >= 80.0:
    orgops.alerts.notify("dlq.capacity.warning", utilization_pct=utilization)
```
